players.product: Revio and Vega HiFi long-read sequencing platforms

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue was $39 million and consumables revenue was $20.1 million, up 6%. The company shipped 20 Revio and 26 Vega systems; clinical consumable shipments increased 67% and Revio annualized pull-through was approximately $202,000.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $39M; consumables $20.1M (+6%); 20 Revio; 26 Vega; clinical shipments +67%

quarterly_data.signal: SPRQ-Nx enables three uses of a SMRT Cell, reducing the consumables cost of a 20x HiFi genome to $345, a 30% reduction. More than one-third of the installed base opted in during June, with more than half expected by the end of the third quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: 3 uses per SMRT Cell; $345 per 20x genome; cost -30%; >1/3 opted in

quarterly_data.signal: Cumulative placements reached 366 Revio and 200 Vega systems; 60% of Revio placements were new customers and 45% were multi-instrument sites. Full-year revenue guidance was revised to $155-$165 million, with year-end cash expected at $175-$185 million.
quarterly_data.figure: 366 Revio; 200 Vega; FY revenue $155M-$165M; YE cash $175M-$185M
